relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: The suppression of adenovirus-shRNA-NLRP3 on postoperative day 1 markedly inhibited the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines and the activation of the inflammasome and mechanical allodynia.

relationships.evidence_quote: The suppression of adenovirus-shRNA-NLRP3 on postoperative day 1 markedly inhibited the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines and the activation of the inflammasome and mechanical allodynia.

key_findings: After inferior alveolar nerve damage NLRP3 inflammasome components rise in microglia of the medullary dorsal horn during days 3-21.
Early shRNA silencing of NLRP3 reduced cytokines, inflammasome activation, microglial cell death and mechanical allodynia.
